name: Alternative Family
source: You will assume the role of a regular guy leading a typical life until he receives a call from an old friend requesting a favor to shelter his family in his home due to the ongoing war. This is where the story takes a turn, as new characters and events will unfold, including encounters with individuals from the protagonist’s past that will resurface. The manner in which the protagonist navigates these challenges is left entirely up to you.
